reasoning.step1:
Step 1 — SOLUTION REASONING:
- Classify document:
  - Contains clear invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Rechnungsbetrag", "Gesamtbetrag", "Umsatzsteuer", invoice numbers/dates, line items. No exclusion terms ("Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") prominently present. → treat as invoice.
- Identify candidate fields and sources:
  - GrandTotal.Amount: "Rechnungsbetrag" line shows "1.642,70" — interpret as 1642.70.
  - Invoice.Date: Several dates present; near "Belegnr. 31686537 v. 02.01.2024" the "v. 02.01.2024" is the invoice issue date. Also delivery and order dates exist, but the invoice header date is 02.01.2024. → use "02.01.2024".
  - Sender.VatId: Two UID values: "UID: ATU22642807" appears under Rechnungsempfänger/Warenempfänger (customer). At document bottom sender company info includes "UID: ATU23264205" (NÖM AG sender). Per rule, sender VAT = sender's UID → "ATU23264205".
  - Vat.Rate / Net.Amount / Vat.Amount:
    - Under "Gesamtsumme" block: "Gesamtbetrag exkl. 1.493,36" → Net.Amount = 1493.36.
    - "Umsatzsteuer 10,00% von 1.493,36 149,34" → Vat.Rate = 10 (drop percent), Vat.Amount = 149.34.
    - Confirm totals: Net 1493.36 + Vat 149.34 = 1642.70 (matches Rechnungsbetrag).
- Apply rules:
  - No inference beyond visible text.
  - Preserve decimal places as in input (two decimals).
  - Return empty strings only if missing — all required fields found.
- Conclusion: extract numeric values as numbers (GrandTotal.Amount 1642.70, Net.Amount 1493.36, Vat.Amount 149.34, Vat.Rate 10) and Invoice.Date "02.01.2024", Sender.VatId "ATU23264205".
